mission_fit.rationale: A body-on-frame V8 GX470 with real 4WD/low-range and a Prinsu roof rack genuinely offers off-road/camping capability the RX 350 does not, fitting the utility_capability mission. evidence.rationale: The listing establishes a 2005 GX470 at 160,428 miles (odometer photo), V8 engine (rear badge photo), asking $14,000 (reduced from $15,000), with the seller describing a partial off-road build (lift-look stance, dual wheel/tire sets, Prinsu roof rack) later abandoned for health reasons. No VIN, title status, owner count, accident history, or any service record is provided; the timing-belt/water-pump interval for this engine is well past typical mileage with zero documentation either way. Photos show a plausible matching tire condition and confirm the vehicle is equipped with a height-control (rear air suspension) system whose function is unverified. No underbody, frame, or engine-bay photos are available in the attached set to evaluate rust or leaks. The asking price sits within the mileage-adjusted comp band but the complete absence of maintenance evidence and the undocumented lift are open, unresolved questions rather than confirmed defects.
evidence.next_action: Request the timing-belt/water-pump service history, title document, and undercarriage/frame photos from the seller, then schedule an independent PPI focused on the drivetrain interval, rear suspension/height-control function, and frame condition before any offer.
